language_task: Put the plastic banana into the pink bowl.
outcome_evidence: The robot approaches and grasps the banana in frames 35–68, then carries it to the bowl in frames 69–90 (wrist_cam and right_base_cam). In frames 92–95, wrist_cam shows the gripper opening and the banana settling inside the bowl. The banana remains in the bowl as the empty gripper withdraws through frame 120, corroborated by left_base_cam and right_base_cam. No failed acquisition or unintended side effect is visible.
